_comment: District diagnostic centres the helpline agent is allowed to name.
Copy this file, fill in the centres from the LUVAS helpline document,
and point REFERRAL_DIRECTORY_PATH at the copy.
Required per entry: district, name. Optional: phone, address, aliases
(other spellings, including Devanagari, that a caller may say).
Entries are read out exactly as written here and are the ONLY centres
the agent may name — it is left empty on purpose so that nothing is
invented before the real list is supplied.
